data.title: Strive Bitcoin Holdings Reach 35,595 BTC As Wall Street Raises Price Target 27%
data.description: TL;DR: TD Cowen reportedly raised its Strive share-price target from $44 to $56 after the Bitcoin treasury company expanded its holdings to 35,595 BTC. Strive is also seeking financing through a substantial preferred-share offering.Bitcoin treasury company Strive is attracting fresh attention from…
